previews.name: diamond-mitotic-seal
previews.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium 2D anime trading-card SUPPORT artwork, one single square full-bleed illustration. Same visual family as our existing shonen character portraits: precise ink contours, detailed cel shading, painterly atmospheric background, cinematic rim light, rich controlled colors, polished anime key visual. Support artwork depicts an iconic technique or relic, NO full human character, NO face. Center the main subject in the middle 60% so a tall portrait card crop preserves it. Large clear silhouette readable as a small tile, dark quieter top/bottom edges. No card frame, typography, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, stars, collage. Subject: Diamond Mitotic Seal, a floating violet diamond-shaped chakra crest, faceted and vivid with thin branching ink-like purple seal markings spreading in a circular pattern. A soft emerald healing aura and a few luminous pink-white lotus petals spiral around it. Ancient stone medical shrine, deep forest shadows, amethyst and emerald light, restrained glowing particles. The seal itself is the hero, absolutely no forehead, body or person. Give it detailed mystical energy rather than a flat app icon.
